author: simondoestuff
body:
Hello I am AndronicusHD, and I was ban from The Avicus 2 years ago. I was younger then and tended to hack all the time. Though I still have server experience I NEVER hack anywhere. I have forbidden myself to hack because I got ban from this server and relized that I need to not hack if I don't want to get ban. Im older now and I don't want to be ban from the server my entire life. This used to be my favorite server and I really want to play. I couldn't find an example of how to Appeal so I just decided to write this message for you. I hope I didn't have to follow a layout in which I can rewrite this.

Thanks,
Simon
